title: H12: Fixed training-only stability audit before portfolio freeze
question: Are any H11 prior-champion gains conditionally stable under two predeclared dependence groupings?
hypothesis: If H11 adopts a continuation over P0, its overall benefit and fast500 noninferiority will be directionally stable in paired conditional bootstrap intervals. This audit cannot establish fresh generalization after adaptive CV selection.
method: No fitting, hyperparameter search, checkpoint selection or candidate reselection. Read only the completed H11 training-only result/prediction files; verify hashes, row alignment, finite predictions and target folds1–4. Fixed comparisons: H11 recorded selection minusP0; H11 selection minusstarting wind control; H11 selection minusfrozenH9; frozenH9 minusP0. Recompute paired ΔRMSE for all cases, observed>=500 and observed>=600, retaining original-window weighting. Primary5000bootstrap draws,seed20261029: union original block IDs whenever they share an identical nominal issue-target pair, then resample these connected block components with replacement, including every associated row. Secondary5000 draws use fixed54-day UTC calendar bins anchored2011-01-01. Report actual cluster sizes/counts, point differences, percentile95%CIs, positive/negative/zero fractions and undefined-replicate counts. Fast subsets are defined by observations, never forecasts; undefined fast subsets remain null. Also verify per-fold and duplicate-aggregation metrics from the saved artifacts. Do not change the selected model after looking at intervals. A passed artifact audit and complete reporting permit freezing regardless of interval direction; uncertainty affects claims, not recipe choice.
inputs: H11 protocol f978fd1e-c27c-4cf9-ae86-faaac54dbc0c and its forthcoming h11_results.json/h11_predictions.npz; actual output hashes recorded by the audit. It contains only the fixed1512training-side validation windows, not originalFold5. Current registration occurs before H11 outcome inspection. Underlying train bundle SHA25626c35997cf19e46e3b83310f17a2a7af42f6ff9726c8727b59fb8cee94fa6d35; EVEbundle8dd7514d63689ffe725bd08738a109184c1a99e02dba045ee1c4a66ae71f8d04.
conditions: Original holdouts remain outside this audit. Every model prediction is fixed; intervals are conditional on adaptive development and do not remove selection optimism. No bootstrap-driven feature, epoch, threshold, mixture or model changes. No use of 600 scores to rescue primary claims. Run locally without additional paid compute. Full paper/final WindNet comparison remains deferred until this audit completes and the portfolio is frozen. Any later original-holdout comparison must be separately preregistered, one-shot, and followed by no further tuning.
success_criteria: For the conditional stability hypothesis only: H11 must have adopted a non-P0 model; both primary and54-day overall ΔRMSE95% upper bounds versusP0 must be below0, and both fast500 upper bounds must be <=1%ofP0's fixed fast500 RMSE. Otherwise report not_supported; if H11 made no adoption, report inconclusive/no new positive claim. Other comparisons and600intervals are descriptive and cannot alter this verdict. Freeze the recorded portfolio regardless, after artifact integrity checks pass; do not treat audit success as independent model-training replication or a test-set improvement.
